jobs.title: Director, SAP Operations
jobs.description:
At VertexOne, helping utilities provide the best customer service experience is what we do. VertexOne is the recognized leader in SaaS platforms for utilities across North America. Through a wide range of innovative services and solutions, VertexOne helps utilities deliver a compelling customer experience; reducing the cost to serve customers, increasing operational efficiency, improving customer satisfaction, and driving utility operations forward. It’s been in the DNA of our people since we started supporting utilities’ customer experience needs over 20 years ago. And that commitment continues to this day.
  
  

Our team members are our greatest assets, so we pride ourselves on being ‘Employee First’. As such, we listen to what our employees have to say and find ways to incorporate their ideas into the company. Whether it’s new technology, career development opportunities, or fun events, we find new ways to keep our employees engaged and incentivized to grow within the company. Our employees' well\-being—both physical and mental—is a top priority at VertexOne. That's why we foster a 100% remote and flexible environment and encourage work\-life balance.
  
  

VertexOne is proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work®. Great Place to Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership behaviors proven to deliver market\-leading revenue, employee retention and increased innovation. VertexOne is dedicated to prioritizing the employee experience and creating an exceptional company culture.
  
  

VertexOne is seeking a Director, SAP Operations to lead a portfolio of utility clients and oversee the delivery of SAP managed services across globally distributed onshore and offshore teams. This role is responsible for client satisfaction, service delivery excellence, operational performance, financial results, and strategic account leadership across complex utility environments.
  
What You'll Do
  
* Lead SAP Application Management Services delivery for multiple utility clients, ensuring high\-quality support and operational excellence.
* Manage globally distributed teams of SAP functional and technical consultants, support analysts, and delivery partners.
* Serve as the executive point of contact for client stakeholders, driving trusted advisor relationships and executive governance.
* Own SLA performance, incident management, service improvement initiatives, and operational KPIs.
* Lead major client escalations, outage communications, and cross\-functional problem resolution.
* Manage vendor and partner relationships to ensure seamless delivery and accountability.
* Oversee portfolio financial performance, including managed services revenue, profitability, utilization, and change requests.
* Drive continuous improvement, governance, compliance, and delivery best practices across the AMS organization.


**Job Requirements/Qualifications:**  

* 10\+ years of experience leading SAP Application Management Services delivery or IT Service Delivery organizations.
* 8\+ years supporting utility clients with deep expertise in SAP IS\-U and Meter\-to\-Cash processes.
* Experience leading onshore/offshore delivery teams and third\-party vendors.
* Strong background in SLA\-driven support organizations, ITIL processes, and operational governance.
* Proven success managing executive client relationships and high\-priority escalations.
* Solid financial and commercial management experience, including managed services contracts and revenue accountability.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred Qualifications
  
* SAP Utilities (IS\-U) expertise across Billing, FICA, Device Management, and Customer Operations.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA transformations, cloud platforms, and 24x7 support environments.
* ITIL and/or SAP certifications.


Success in this role means delivering exceptional client outcomes, leading high\-performing global teams, achieving operational and financial targets, and serving as a trusted strategic partner to utility clients.
  
  

**What VertexOne has to offer:**  

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs)
* 401K match
* Flexible PTO
* Employee recognition platform with monetary rewards
* 100% Remote work environment
* Initial work from home stipend
* Leadership/Coaching training programs
* Free access to Bizlibrary for unlimited professional development
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling sessions available 24/7
* Health and wellbeing programs
* Paid parental leave
* Employee bonus referral program
* Employee Discount Program


**About VertexOne:**  

VertexOne is the leading provider of cloud\-based SaaS software solutions powering the next generation of customer experience for utilities, energy retailers, and energy transition providers.
  
  

With over 30 years of experience and more than 350 customers in the cloud, we capitalize on our deep expertise to provide a wide range of innovative solutions for digital transformation, revenue optimization, and data\-driven efficiency operations surrounding the customer.
  
  

From Customer Information Systems (CIS) and Mobile Workforce Management (MWM) to Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) and Digital Customer Engagement and self\-service portals, we empower our customers to deliver a compelling customer experience, reduce costs to serve, increase operational efficiency, and improve customer satisfaction.
  
  

For more information on how VertexOne allows you to enhance the digital customer experience, improve revenue management, and leverage data analytics, visit https://www.vertexone.net.

VertexOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital

jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client\-focused, AI\-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end\-to\-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.

 **You Are:**


We are looking for an experienced SAP Sales \& Distribution (SD) Manager/Senior Manager to lead large\-scale sales, order management, billing, and customer revenue transformation programs for clients across the Communications, Media \& Technology (CMT) and High\-Tech industries. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in SAP Sales \& Distribution, Order\-to\-Cash (OTC) processes, Billing \& Invoicing, Pricing, Customer Contracts, and Revenue Integration with strong leadership capabilities, client relationship management skills, and a proven track record of delivering complex SAP S/4HANA business transformation programs.

 **The Work:**

* Lead end\-to\-end SAP Sales \& Distribution (SD), Order\-to\-Cash (OTC), Billing, and Invoicing transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Own overall program governance, delivery timelines, budget, and risk management.
* Drive solution architecture decisions and ensure alignment with client's long\-term logistics, fulfillment, transportation, and customer delivery strategy.
* Oversee multiple workstreams and manage cross\-functional teams of consultants, developers, and client stakeholders.
* Provide hands\-on leadership for SAP SD solution design, including sales order management, pricing, contracts, billing, invoicing, returns processing, credit and debit memo management, customer rebates, and output management.
* Lead billing and invoicing transformation initiatives, including subscription billing, recurring revenue models, intercompany billing, electronic invoicing, and automated invoice processing.
* Review and approve functional specifications, configuration documents, and test scripts
* Drive integration design across SAP SD, Finance (FI\-AR), Revenue Accounting, BRIM, CRM/CX, CPQ, EWM, TM, and external eCommerce and customer management platforms.
* Lead SIT, UAT, and cutover planning; develop configuration and test documentation.
* Mentor junior consultants and solution leads, build client capabilities, and support business development efforts through solution innovation and thought leadership.

 *Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirement*s


  

What you Need:

* Minimum of 5 years of hands\-on experience designing, configuring, and delivering SAP Order\-to\-Cash (OTC) and SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) solutions, including Billing and Invoicing *(preferred),* sales order management, pricing, and customer order management.
* Minimum of 3 full\-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations, including at least 2 years serving in a functional lead or solution lead capacity for SAP SD, OTC, billing *(preferred)*, or invoicing *(preferred)* workstreams.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience designing and delivering sales operations, order fulfillment, pricing, billing *(preferred)* and invoicing *(preferred),* accounts receivable integration, and revenue lifecycle management processes.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience delivering SAP sales, order management, billing *(preferred),* invoicing *(preferred),* or revenue transformation solutions for clients in Communications, Media \& Technology (CMT) and High Tech industries
* Minimum of 3 years of consulting or advisory experience leading client workshops and solution design sessions, translating business requirements into SAP solutions, and presenting recommendations to senior or executive stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree or a minimum of 12 years of equivalent work experience; candidates with an associate degree must have a minimum of 6 years of work experience.

  

Bonus Points If:

* You are an SAP Certified Application Associate in SAP S/4HANA Sales or equivalent SAP SD certification.
* You have an SAP Activate methodology certification or equivalent agile delivery experience

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

 **We anticipate this job posting will be posted until 11/15/2026\.**  

  

Accenture offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long\-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off.

jobs.description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.
   

  

**Primary Job Purpose**
 The SAP S/4HANA SD Reginal Application Consultant is responsible for providing SAP SD application support, continuous improvement, and rollout execution services for business units across the Americas region.
   

  

 Working within an established global SAP template and governance model, the role will support business operations, deliver approved enhancements, participate in rollout activities, and promote adoption of standardized Quote\-to\-Cash processes. The position operates under the governance and design authority of the Global SAP CoE, ensuring alignment with global standards, best practices, and template integrity.
   

  

**Key Position Accountabilities**
* Serve as the primary SAP SD Regional Consultant supporting business units across the Americas region.
* Act as the primary point of contact for SAP SD production support, incident resolution, service requests, and operational stabilization activities.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business requirements and assess alignment with approved global template capabilities.
* Ensure all solutions, enhancements, and process recommendations comply with approved global SAP templates, standards, and governance policies.
* Configure and support SAP SD processes including:
+ Customer and Sales Master Data
+ Quotations
+ Sales Orders
+ Sales Contracts
+ Pricing
+ ATP (Available\-to\-Promise)
+ Delivery Processing
+ Billing
+ Returns Management
+ Credit Management

* Recommend standard SAP solutions aligned with global template standards while minimizing custom developments and regional deviations.
* Work with technical teams to design, test, and deploy WRICEF objects including reports, interfaces, enhancements, workflows, conversions, and forms.
* Develop and maintain functional specifications and support technical design reviews.
* Support data migration activities including customer master, pricing conditions, open sales orders, and related transactional data.
* Coordinate and execute system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), training, cutover, go\-live, and hypercare activities.
* Collaborate closely with MM, FI, PP, EWM, BRIM and other functional teams to ensure seamless end\-to\-end business processes.
* Drive root cause analysis and reduction of recurring incidents through process improvements, knowledge sharing, and proactive support activities.
* Investigate and resolve production incidents and service requests while meeting agreed service levels.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to optimize business processes and user experience.
* Collaborate with the Global SAP CoE to evaluate enhancement requests, support process standardization, and ensure compliance with governance processes.
* Participate in design reviews, deployment activities, governance forums, and change control processes as required.

* Operate within the governance framework established by the Global SAP CoE.
* Global process ownership, template ownership, and solution design authority remain with the Global SAP CoE.
* This role may recommend improvements and provide business impact assessments but is not responsible for approving regional process deviations or template changes.
* Requests for process changes, template deviations, or new solution capabilities must follow established SAP CoE governance and approval processes.
* Support business stakeholders in adopting approved global standards and minimizing regional customizations.

* Essential
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Minimum 5 \-7 years of SAP SD consulting, support, and solution delivery experience.
* Minimum 1 full lifecycle SAP implementations or S/4HANA rollout projects in SAP SD.
* Strong hands\-on SAP SD configuration experience covering:
+ Quotations
+ Sales Contracts
+ Sales Order Management
+ Pricing

+ Delivery Processing
+ Billing
+ Returns
+ Credit Management

* Experience supporting regional or global SAP rollout programs.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Quote\-to\-Cash processes and integration points with MM, FI, PP, EWM, and other SAP modules.
* Experience creating functional specifications for enhancements, interfaces, reports, forms, and workflows.
* Experience with testing, cutover planning, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
* Experience supporting production environments, incident management, and change request delivery.
* Experience working within a globally governed SAP environment utilizing standardized templates and processes.
* Demonstrated ability to balance production support, continuous improvement, and rollout activities.
* Proven experience driving adoption of standardized business processes across regional business units.
* Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP Fiori applications.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

You have spent years in the SAP BRIM world, building systems that actually process millions in revenue, not just configurations that look good in a demo. You understand that billing is never just billing. It is contracts, pricing, usage data, integrations that break at 2am, and finance teams who need their numbers to reconcile perfectly every single time. You have sat in enough design sessions to know when a requirement sounds simple but will create technical debt six months down the line, and you speak up before it gets built.


You are equally comfortable whiteboarding a solution architecture with a VP of Finance and debugging a FI\-CA posting issue in a sandbox. You do not need a perfect spec to get started. You ask the right questions, map the dependencies, and build something that scales. When a business user says "we need flexible billing," you know how to translate that into Convergent Invoicing configuration, integration touchpoints, and a test plan that actually covers edge cases. * Enable accurate and timely revenue recognition across complex subscription and usage\-based business models that directly affect financial reporting

* Reduce manual intervention and billing errors by designing automated, exception\-based workflows that finance teams can trust

* Accelerate time\-to\-market for new pricing models and contract types by building flexible, configurable BRIM solutions
* Strengthen system reliability and uptime for mission\-critical finance operations that process invoices and revenue for a global customer base
* Contribute technical and functional expertise that elevates the team's ability to deliver high\-quality solutions on aggressive timelines
